scope: Interoperability findings for live readings, schedules, cloud music, sleep reports and stored timer profiles. The 0.5.1 history export command was verified on a physical REMI and refreshed its current journal. Other 0.5 device writes are verified with simulated API responses, not physical playback or timer execution.

source.method: Blutter annotated ARM64 disassembly; addresses refer only to this build.
source.redistribution: No app binaries or decompiled source are included. This file records interoperability findings.

temperature.status: Implemented and tested with fractional values preserved.
temperature.limitation: A correct conversion and decimal display do not establish sensor calibration or physical accuracy.

alarms.status: Cloud clock-time edits, service field fixes and weekday labels implemented. Reading verified on HA 2026.11.0; writes tested with mocked API responses.
alarms.weekday_evidence: Existing cloud arrays matched the weekly view in the REMI app, which starts on Monday.
alarms.service_compatibility: The existing public repeat input still uses Sunday=0 through Saturday=6; it is converted to the Monday-first array.
alarms.clock_timezone: Device local time; no UTC date is synthesized.

additional_fields.music_path: Relative file path or empty string
additional_fields.cmd: Only app formats 10, 11, 14, 15 are modified; bit 2 controls Play and bit 0 is preserved.

additional_evidence.music_length: The duration picker supplies whole minutes; EventModel field_2f serializes directly as length_min. Saving the form forwards that integer into EventModel.

music_mode.status: Corrected option labels; device playback not exercised.
music_mode.evidence: Icon mapping: oneDisable, oneEnable, repeat1Enable and repeatEnable for modes 0, 1, 2 and 3 respectively.

night_face_brightness.status: Implemented with mocked command and HA service tests; physical effect not yet tested.
night_face_brightness.conversion: The app rounds its slider value to an integer and writes it directly, without scaling.
night_face_brightness.distinction: light_min controls face brightness in the dark; the separate 0-100 luminosity setting controls the nightlight. No calibration or face-selection command is sent.

firmware.status: Device-specific eligibility implemented; firmware installation not implemented.
firmware.interpretation: The server-wide default is not proof that an update has been assigned to this REMI.

music_control.nonce: Random integer from 0 through 999; consecutive identical nonces avoided.
music_control.evidence: CurrentRemi musicPath 0x64ce40; serializeRemiCommand 0x5614c0; music updateMusicPath 0x843d7c; mini-player pause 0x88514c and stop 0x884d04.
music_control.library: Class Music, uppercase REMI owner via $select on selected Remi.objectId; full path joins path and file. Read budget 200 with overflow detection.
music_control.library_evidence: Library getter 0x58319c; Parse SDK whereMatchesKeyInQuery 0x579d04; MusicModel 0x583d1c..0x583d84.
music_control.limitations: Cloud command text is not playback telemetry. No confirmed playing/paused/position state; Play restarts a selected known file. Previous/next choose known neighbors in the same folder.

sleep_history.metadata: Own-device noise_logs with SleepInfo pointers; catalogue of at most 60 available journals, not necessarily consecutive days.
sleep_history.period: The app uses the UTC calendar date of timestamp as the period end, and the previous date as the start. Its timestamp hour does not identify the latest export or establish an absolute sample time.
sleep_history.freshness: updated_at reflects the journal's cloud updatedAt. report_age_days and stale use this value, independently of log_timestamp and Home Assistant fetched_at; stale is true after 48 hours, unknown when freshness cannot be established.
sleep_history.native_sensor_selection: Prefer the latest completed report with a positive sleep duration or score. If none exists, use the latest report without inventing missing estimates. The card displays one selected journal consistently across values and charts.
sleep_history.sleep_placeholders: The app's zero sleepDuration and zero score are exposed as null. A clock time of 00:00 for bedtime or wake-up is valid and retained.
sleep_history.files: data, tempData and lightData Parse files; 720 uint8 values at two-minute spacing.
sleep_history.clock_grid: 12:00 through 11:58, following the app. Absolute sample dates are not established.
sleep_history.temperature_chart_celsius: For nonzero bytes, raw * 50 / 255 - 10; not the live temperature formula. A zero temperature byte is ambiguous, so value and graph_value are null, valid is false, and raw_value remains 0.
sleep_history.zero_handling: Noise and light zeroes remain valid. Temperature zeroes are not asserted to be physical -10 C readings or proven missing slots. Chart lines do not bridge invalid or missing samples. No rule declares all zeroes or boundary bytes absent.

action.name: get_history
action.limit: Default 2; metadata accepts 1..60. With include_series=true and no report_id, the maximum is 2.
action.include_series: Default true; false returns the catalogue without downloading binary charts.
action.report_id: Optional identifier from the selected REMI's available catalogue; returns one selected journal.
action.refresh: Default false; true rereads cloud metadata and clears cached chart files without requesting a device export by itself.
action.sync: Default false; an explicit true sends a history export command before refreshing the cloud. Normal polling and card navigation never send it automatically.

export_command.result: sync_status is requested for a new command, cooldown for a cloud-only reread during the cooldown, or null when no sync was requested. Requested is not confirmation that all expected data arrived.
export_command.physical_validation: The explicit command refreshed the current journal on a physical REMI. Recovery of missing earlier days and completion of sleep estimates are not established.

sleep_history.limitations: Reports can be old, incomplete or absent. Period dates and cloud update time are distinct; no absolute sample timestamps or recorder backfill are invented. Raw boundary bytes are retained without claiming sensor calibration or a universal missing-data encoding.

timer_profiles.duration: [hours, minutes], each bounded to 0..23 and 0..59; positive service duration 1..1439 minutes.
timer_profiles.music_duration: lengthStart and lengthEnd are minutes, 0 when duration option is disabled.
timer_profiles.evidence: NapModel.toJson 0x57a344; constructor 0x57b550..0x57b5a4; music picker 0x84fe74..0x84feb8; nap callback 0x8373cc; saveEvent 0x837b34/0x837b40.
timer_profiles.supported: List, create, patch supplied fields and delete, after ownership checks.
timer_profiles.limitations: No verified cloud command chain to start/stop a timer. Physical activation only; no invented countdown.
